screening_decisions.reason: Randomised double-blind placebo-controlled trial of aminophylline (theophylline analogue) in acute ischemic stroke; meets all selection criteria.
Randomised double-blind placebo-controlled trial of intravenous aminophylline in acute cerebral infarction; meets criteria.
Single-arm dose-escalation study without a placebo or control group; does not meet the requirement for a randomised controlled trial.
Primary intervention is vincamin, not theophylline or analogue; not a randomised trial of the target compounds.

Randomised double-blind cross-over trial of caffeine (analogue) versus placebo in patients recovering from acute ischaemic stroke; meets criteria, though time from onset is unclear, include conservatively.
Randomised double-blind cross-over trial of caffeine versus placebo in patients with acute ischaemic stroke; meets criteria, include conservatively.
Not a randomised controlled trial; a physiological measurement study without a control group.
Animal experiment in cats, not a human randomised trial; does not meet inclusion criteria.
Animal study in dogs, not a randomised trial of theophylline/analogue in human acute stroke.
Narrative review from 1953, not a randomised controlled trial; does not present original trial data.
